hints.title: Poison Interval Overlap Capping
hints.text: When a new attack lands before the previous poison duration expires, the poison timer simply resets, creating an interval overlap.

hints.title: Minimum Duration Difference Invariant
hints.text: The poison duration added between consecutive attack timestamps is capped at the minimum of duration and the time difference between attacks.

hints.title: Consecutive Difference Summation Procedure
hints.text: If time series is empty, return zero. Initialize total poison time to zero. For each attack before the last, add min(duration, next timestamp minus current timestamp). Add full duration for the final attack and return total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracking poisoned seconds in a hash set takes O(N * duration) time and allocates massive memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan over attack timestamps computes total poisoned seconds in O(N) time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that adjacent attacks contribute min(duration, delta) and avoid simulating individual seconds.
